text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(—A heat is swirling. A fiery passion 
honed just for this day—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(Clashing together and making sparks fly! 
Hot, hot, so hot—this is awesome!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufu, ahaha, ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, to think Katsuragi Ace would take it! 
What a shock!

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Still, I ended up watching C.B., didn't I? 
Maybe running one more time is what makes 
C.B. who she is.

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think so too. I can definitely 
take the Kikuka Sho! The dream of being 
the strongest in history isn't over yet!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator
text_block_list.text:
No, no, she lost today. Besides, the 
greatest of all time is that girl called a 
legend. After all, she's a five-time G1 
winner.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"CB is strong and all, but the fact is, 
she didn't win."

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
No way, CB is seriously gonna blow right 
past them!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Even if we lost today, it starts now! 
She's an Umamusume who can win 5... no, 
even 6 GⅠ races!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. fell just one step short at the 
Japan Derby.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And yet that day, for some reason, she 
walked home with a bouncy, dance-like 
spring in her step.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm frustrated about losing. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! It was fun. It was heated—there 
couldn't have been a better stage...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear Ace's voice? I was so 
thrilled—it felt like a true roar of 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho is next, huh? I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, hey! It's Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following her gaze, I saw Symboli Rudolf 
running on the TV of an electronics store.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Feature on Promising Newcomer 
Umamusume!", huh... As expected of Rudolf! 
You're already drawing so much attention.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...She's finally making her appearance 
too. I wonder how much she's transformed 
over this past year."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Heheh! The Twinkle Series is just 
full of exciting things...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Dammit allllll!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *wheeze*, *gasp*...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though I won... All they were 
looking at was CB...!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I'll become an 'ace' that defies all 
common sense", huh. "I'll show them all", 
huh...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I'm nothing more than a stepping stone—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Once summer passes and autumn arrives, 
it'll be the Kikuka Sho. The final race of 
the Classic Triple Crown, and the third 
major showdown against Katsuragi Ace.
